interaction_history.summary: Policy onboarding completed. Policyholder signed up for a 4-coverage plan including Personal Liability, Property Damage, Medical Payments, and Roadside Assistance.
Policyholder enquired about Roadside Assistance coverage limits. Confirmed 24/7 towing up to 50 miles per incident. No changes requested.
Annual premium review sent. Policyholder acknowledged receipt. No coverage changes at this time.
Policyholder reported a minor billing discrepancy on the December statement. Issue traced to a rounding error. Corrected and confirmation sent.
Policy document 61356291 generated from EDI purchase order. 4 coverage items: Personal Liability, Property Damage, Medical Payments, Roadside Assistance. Total gross: $102.84/mo.
Policyholder requested removal of Roadside Assistance (Item 4, $12.00 net). Policy document amended, PDF regenerated. New gross: $89.64/mo.
Support agent raised HelpDesk ticket #1025 for premium adjustment processing. Ticket shared with policyholder via Matrix.
